matched_job_text: Matched-job extra pairs proposed=38, uncached=38, estimated extra USD=0.27032022. Included under --max-cost. Paired Wilcoxon on 52 jobs with both sides in the scored set: p=0.04009302215777456, rank_biserial=0.33031674208144796 (No Fit gap vs fit-positive gap, within job).
deviations: Holdout-30 fit-positive pair ids could not be reconstructed from `sample_experiment_pairs` with seed 2026 on the 150-pool; NF-holdout uses seed 2026 on remaining No Fit train rows (the documented holdout seed), not a reverse-engineered undocumented holdout filter.

Priority-weighted gap share uses requirement priority base weights (required=1.0, preferred=0.6, unspecified=0.8), not stored match-dependent `ProfileGap.weight` (that weight includes severity and evidence and would mix the outcome into the weight).
Mismatched control uses the existing `mismatched_partner_indices` per fit-label group so partners stay in the same human label.
